[[Al Ain FC|Al Ain]] would win its fourteenth title after beating the defending champions Al Jazira 5–0 the eleventh of May. ==Teams== ===Team changes=== ====Promoted to the Pro League==== Both [[Al Urooba]] and [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] secured promotion on the same day after beating [[Al Dhaid SC|Al Dhaid]] 3–0 and [[Masafi Club|Masafi]] 6–0 on the second last matchday.{{cite web|url=https://www.albayan.ae/sports/emirates/2021-04-17-1.4143348|title=العروبة بطلاً لدوري الهواة والإمارات يحسم بطاقة الصعود الثانية|publisher=albayan|language=ar|access-date=17 April 2020}} [[Emirates Club|Emirates]] is returning after getting relegated two seasons ago in [[2018–19 UAE Pro League|2018–19 season]] meanwhile [[Al Urooba]] is getting promoted back to the top tier after almost three decades of absence, only previously being in the competition in [[1992–93 UAE Football League|1992–93 season]]. ====Relegated to the First Division==== On 7 May, despite winning 4–0 against [[Al-Ittihad Kalba SC|Kalba]], [[Hatta Club|Hatta]] was confirmed relegated back to the [[UAE First Division League|First Division]] after only spending two seasons on the top flight.{{cite web|url=https://www.albayan.ae/sports/emirates/2021-05-08-1.4159659|title=حتا.. القطار فات والصحوة متأخرة|publisher=albayan|access-date=8 May 2021|language=ar}} On 11 May, [[Fujairah FC|Fujairah]] got relegated after a 2–1 defeat to [[Ajman Club|Ajman]], both clubs were battling relegation and needed a victory. ===Stadia and locations===
